en: A sepia-toned photographic portrait postcard of an elderly man with a large white beard, dressed in a military-style uniform with medals. He is seated in an elegant interior with paneled walls, resting one arm on a table. The caption at the bottom identifies him as the Grand Duke of Baden, and there is a printed date of 28 September 1907 along with the publisher's imprint in small text.
